Title- Ios Developer
 

 Location- Austin ,TX 78759
 

 Duration- 12 months
 

 Job description:
 

 Looking for someone at a senior level – to implement features 80%, help juniors 5%, code reviews 15%.

 Everything in Swift 2.3 plans to upgrade to Swift 3 (Exp with Swift 3 is a bonus). Swift exp- at least 1 yr
 5 yrs exp in iOS development, objective C
 Unit test development is a strong desire
 Agile, SCRUM, Jira, bitbucket nice to have
 Mobile apps is what client is looking for native.
 Interview process- fairly easy phone interview by Bruce Paggeot
 Coding challenge and then onsite/ skype interviews with tech lead, architect
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
